categories.main_business_segments: Chong Hong Construction Co., Ltd. primarily engages in real estate development, focusing on the sale and leasing of commercial office buildings, residential buildings, and industrial plants. The company also undertakes land consolidation, development, and planning, and is involved in the purchase, sale, and import/export of construction materials and machinery. Its projects include high-grade residential housing, commercial real estate, and mixed-use residential and commercial buildings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company outsources construction work to qualified contractors, primarily its wholly-owned subsidiary Hong Lin Construction Co., Ltd., which manages construction progress and quality. It employs advanced computer graphics systems for building design and collaborates with internationally renowned design teams. The company emphasizes new workmanship, building materials, and construction management to control costs and quality. It also promotes corporate computerization to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chong Hong serves individual homebuyers and corporate clients in the Greater Taipei and Greater Taichung areas, focusing on residential housing, commercial office buildings, and industrial factories. The company targets customers seeking high-quality, well-located properties near MRT stations, green spaces, and good school districts. It also caters to technology industry employees in central and southern Taiwan due to rising housing demand in those regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are concentrated in Taiwan, primarily in the Greater Taipei area including Taipei City and New Taipei City, as well as the Greater Taichung area. It also has projects in Taoyuan, Changhua, and other central and southern regions of Taiwan, focusing on urban renewal and areas with strong development potential.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chong Hong operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, development, planning, and property sales and leasing. Construction is outsourced to contractors, notably its subsidiary, placing it upstream in land development and midstream in project management, with downstream activities in sales and property management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes market research, urban renewal projects, and product positioning to meet customer demands. It invests in building design innovation using advanced computer graphics and collaborates with international design teams. Construction engineering administration focuses on new workmanship and materials to improve quality and cost control. The company also emphasizes corporate computerization and ESG performance improvement to create competitive advantages and sustainable operations.
categories.revenue_model: Chong Hong generates revenue primarily through the sale and leasing of developed real estate properties, including residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Additional income streams include construction contract income and rental revenues from owned properties. The company does not engage in subscription or licensing models but relies on project-based sales and leasing contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other regional real estate developers such as Farglory Land Development Co., Ltd., Huaku Development Co., Ltd., Hong Pu Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., and Highwealth Corporation. It positions itself as a reputable developer with strong land acquisition capabilities, quality construction management, and a focus on high-quality, well-located projects, maintaining a moderate project portfolio with a conservative and prudent business approach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chong Hong reported consolidated operating income of approximately NT$12.07 billion, a 23% increase from 2023, and a net profit of about NT$2.28 billion, up 24% year-over-year. The company has a strong financial base with total assets of around NT$46.65 billion and equity of NT$21.31 billion. It maintains stable cash flows, a sound financial structure, and steady growth driven by increased project deliveries and sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chong Hong emphasizes high-quality construction, strategic land acquisition in prime locations, and comprehensive product planning tailored to market demands. It differentiates through its strong brand reputation, professional management team, and integrated construction control via its subsidiary. The company also focuses on safety, comfort, environmental sustainability, and after-sale service to enhance customer trust and satisfaction, supporting sustainable operation and competitive advantage.
